name: kanban-task-worker
description: Chief Wiggum style worker for executing tasks from a markdown kanban.

entrypoints.title: Work a kanban task
entrypoints.description: Select or execute one Chief Wiggum formatted kanban task in a repository workspace.

kanban_path.description: Path to the markdown kanban file, relative to the workspace or absolute.

task_id.description: Task ID to execute, or AUTO to select the first eligible pending task.

parameters.name: task_policy
parameters.description: Worker policy: fast, default, readonly-plan, or fix-only.

parameters.name: validation_command
parameters.description: Command to run for final validation, or none.

parameters.name: max_workers
parameters.description: Number of worker tasks permitted to run in parallel.

constraints: Respect kanban dependencies; only [x] tasks satisfy dependencies.
Do not commit or stage; leave changes for the orchestrator.
success_criteria: One eligible task is completed or a blocker is reported.
The kanban task status and RESULT artifact reflect the final state.
Validation evidence is included when a validation command is provided.
